name: Alcohol Abuse
overview: Scripture warns clearly against the dangers of alcohol abuse, portraying wine and strong drink as deceptive and destructive forces that bring sorrow, contention, and physical harm. Those who indulge excessively are cautioned as unwise and self-harming, with repeated 'woes' pronounced on those who rise early to pursue strong drink and who are mighty to drink. Loving pleasure through wine leads to poverty and ruin, contrasting with the merciful who do good to their own soul. These verses emphasize the importance of self-control and wisdom in avoiding the ruin that comes from drunkenness.
